memory_annotations.evidence_summary: Avery selected a later Friday nonstop to preserve working time after the newly required 10:00 a.m. crate check, canceled the unusable American return for credit, and added a separately priced hotel night linked to the original reservation so she could remain in the same room. These decisions apply only to this assignment extension and do not establish a recurring travel preference.

messages.content: I'm still in St. Louis. During this morning's condition review, we found a crate reading that has to be checked again at 10:00 a.m. Friday. The Atlanta team has reassigned tomorrow morning's carrier handoff, so I need to stay here tonight and return after the second check.

Understood. Your American itinerary for this morning is no longer usable, and the Cheshire reservation ends today. I'll look for a Friday departure that leaves enough time after the 10:00 a.m. check, and I'll confirm whether the hotel can extend your stay without changing rooms. About what time do you expect to leave the museum?
The second reading should take about 45 minutes. Allow another half hour for notes, so I could leave around 11:15. I don't want a flight that depends on getting out early.

For Friday, October 16, the practical nonstop options from STL to ATL are Southwest WN 1963 at 2:25 p.m., arriving 4:58 p.m., for $238, and Delta DL 1736 at 4:05 p.m., arriving 6:34 p.m., for $271. Both allow the checked supply case. The Southwest flight would give you roughly two hours at the airport if you leave the museum at 11:15; Delta provides substantially more margin.
Take the Delta flight. I would rather have the extra time in case the notes run long. Can the American ticket value be applied?

The unused American ticket can be canceled for a $246 flight credit, but that credit cannot be transferred to Delta. The Delta fare would be a new $271 charge. Shall I cancel American for the credit and book Delta DL 1736?
Yes, do both. Keep the supply case on the booking.

American confirmation K4N7PC has been canceled, and a $246 credit has been issued in Avery Thompson's name. Delta DL 1736 is booked for Friday, October 16, departing STL at 4:05 p.m. and arriving ATL at 6:34 p.m. The checked supply case is included. New confirmation: D8R5MW. Total charged: $271.
Now handle tonight at the Cheshire. The front desk told me they can leave me in the same king room, but it has to be a separate reservation at today's price.

The Cheshire has the same king room available for Thursday night at $189 plus $31.47 in taxes and mandatory fees, for a total of $220.47. They can link it to CHS-804621 so you remain in the room, although the additional night will have its own confirmation. Cancellation is no longer available because check-in is today. Would you like me to book it using the payment method on file?
Book it. Please make sure the linked-reservation note is explicit so housekeeping doesn't expect me to move or check out between them.

The additional night, October 15-16, is booked for $220.47 on the payment method on file. Confirmation: CHS-917340. The hotel linked it to CHS-804621 and added instructions to keep you in the same king room with no interim checkout or room move. Friday checkout is 11:00 a.m.
Eleven is too early because I'll be at the museum. Can they hold my suitcase and supply case after checkout, or offer a late checkout that would actually help?

A 1:00 p.m. late checkout is available for $45, but it would not help if you are already at the museum. The front desk can instead store both the suitcase and supply case after an early departure. You could leave them at the desk before the 10:00 a.m. check, retrieve them after finishing, and then continue to the airport.
Use storage, no late checkout fee. Give me one revised itinerary with the canceled flight, hotel extension, Friday work, and new return all reconciled.

Revised St. Louis itinerary for Avery Thompson: The original Cheshire stay remains October 12-15 under CHS-804621 for $663.39. One additional night, October 15-16, is confirmed under CHS-917340 for $220.47; the reservations are linked, and the hotel has confirmed no room move or interim checkout. On Friday morning, leave the suitcase and checked supply case with the front desk before going to the museum. The second crate reading begins at 10:00 a.m.; allow through approximately 11:15 a.m. for the check and notes, then retrieve the stored bags and proceed to STL. American flights AA 1847 and AA 521 under K4N7PC are canceled, with a $246 credit issued in your name. The new return is Delta DL 1736 on Friday, October 16, departing STL at 4:05 p.m. and arriving ATL at 6:34 p.m., confirmation D8R5MW. The checked supply case is included, and the new airfare charged is $271. Southwest WN 2418 under L8Q2RM remains the completed outbound.
